components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action in a group, such as Copy Markdown.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: Geist, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; min-height: 46px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: #334b2e; color: #fffef9; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2a3f26; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #54793e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting actions beside the primary, such as Download PNG.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: Geist, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; min-height: 46px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #aeb7a6; border-radius: 8px; background: #fffef9; color: #242922; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #596154; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #54793e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labelled field with a hint underneath.
components.css: .ds-field { font-family: Geist, Arial, sans-serif; display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #242922; font-size: 14px; max-width: 300px; } .ds-field input { font: 500 15px/1.5 Geist, Arial, sans-serif; min-height: 46px; padding: 11px 12px; border: 1px solid #aeb7a6; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #242922; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #54793e; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-field small { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; color: #596154; }

components.name: Option Tile
components.description: Pressable choice for format, layout or style.
components.css: .ds-options { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-option { font-family: Geist, Arial, sans-serif; display: grid; gap: 4px; text-align: left; padding: 14px 10px; min-width: 130px; border: 1px solid #adb7a5; border-radius: 8px; background: #fffef9; color: #242922; cursor: pointer; } .ds-option strong { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-option small { font-size: 11px; color: #596154; } .ds-option[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: #334b2e; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #334b2e; background: #e9eee2; } .ds-option:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #54793e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Embed/Print Switch
components.css: .ds-switch { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 9px; background: #edf0e7; } .ds-switch a { font-family: Geist, Arial, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 6px; color: #4e5848; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-switch a[aria-current="page"] { background: #fffef9; color: #263922; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px #17231f14; } .ds-switch a:hover { color: #17231f; } .ds-switch a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #466743; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Notice
components.description: Informational warning with an inline action.
components.html: This address came from the link you opened.
components.css: .ds-notice { font-family: Geist, Arial, sans-serif; max-width: 300px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: #f6efdc; color: #4d3b12; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-notice button { display: block; min-height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: inherit; font: 600 13px Geist, Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Share Panel
components.description: Cream panel on the stage holding embed code and actions.
components.css: .ds-panel { font-family: Geist, Arial, sans-serif; max-width: 360px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #c9cec2; border-radius: 12px; background: #fffef9; color: #242922; } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.3px; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: #596154; }

narrative.overview: The Embed editor is a quiet desk for composing one small card. Everything around the card is cream paper, linen and dry sage, set in Geist with tight editorial headlines and Geist Mono for code. The card itself is the only object allowed real colour: its eight styles, the Vizorcat character and the QR carry the personality, while the desk stays calm enough that a creator can judge the card as it will look in a README.
keyCharacteristics: Cream and linen surfaces, one deep forest accent, no decorative gradients in the chrome.
The support card is the most saturated thing on screen.
Geist throughout, Geist Mono only for embed code and addresses.
Tonal layers instead of elevation; shadows only under the card and floating pills.
44px minimum interactive height, visible 3px focus outline.

rules.name: The Card Owns the Colour Rule
rules.body: Chrome stays within the sage, linen and cream neutrals plus Deep Forest. Saturated hues belong to the card styles, not to the editor around them.

rules.name: The No New Greys Rule
rules.body: Reuse the neutral tokens above. The incumbent CSS carries a dozen near-duplicate one-off greens and greys (for example #f1f4eb, #f0f2ed, #e1e8d5); new work must not add more, and touched code should fold them into the nearest token.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Chrome is set in Geist and Geist Mono only. Card-only faces (Silkscreen, Zarathustra, Space Grotesk) never appear in editor chrome except inside style thumbnails that preview a card.

rules.name: The Only the Card Floats Rule
rules.body: Panels, fields and buttons sit flat on their surface; a shadow means "this is the card or floats over the desk".

dos: Do keep the card the most colourful element on screen; chrome stays in the neutral tokens plus Deep Forest.
Do use one Deep Forest primary button per action group; everything else is secondary or a text action.
Do make every interactive element at least 44px tall and keep the 3px Moss Focus outline visible.
Do put helper text in 13px Lichen directly under the control it explains.
Do separate surfaces by tone (linen, paper, stage) and hairlines before reaching for a shadow.
Do keep the card in view while the creator makes design choices; the preview stage is sticky beside the steps.
donts: Don't add new one-off greys or greens; use the neutral tokens (The No New Greys Rule).
Don't set chrome text in Arial or card-only faces.
Don't let any card layer, surface or companion cover the QR or its four-module quiet zone.
Don't add decorative shadows to panels, fields or buttons (The Only the Card Floats Rule).
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading; the heading carries its own weight.
